$comment: What the signin resource deploys into the environment's Microsoft Entra External ID tenant (K4b), applied through Microsoft Graph by the orchestrator's graph driver: the API's registration (its scope, and the Operator app role our own people are granted with `deploy grant-operator`), one single-page app registration per staff app with its redirect URIs per environment and consent to the scope, and the sign-up and sign-in user flow (email one-time codes) those apps use. Names are the resource's own name with a suffix, so each environment's are its own. The tenant itself comes from `deploy bootstrap-signin`.

scope.displayName: Use HospitalityOS as the signed-in staff member

appRoles.description: Operates the platform: may invite a customer's first administrator.
